tracks.title: 合鍵のステップ
tracks.subject: a woman whose landlord's copied spare key only opens her door if she lifts it, pulls it back a millimetre and turns it left on the beat, so every night in the corridor she ends up dancing the landlord's instructions

tracks.title: のれんが逆
tracks.genre: Japanese Y2K laid-back pop-rap duo revival
tracks.subject: two college friends at a hot-spring inn who stand frozen at dawn outside the baths because the red and blue noren swapped sides overnight, arguing in yukata until an old guest shuffles by and explains the 5 a.m. men's/women's changeover

tracks.title: 湯たんぽの温度
tracks.subject: a man who boils the kettle at eleven every winter night to fill a hot-water bottle and tuck it on his partner's side of the futon before she gets home from her late shift, checking it with his own hand like a nurse

tracks.title: 死んだふりのミケ
tracks.subject: a woman whose tabby cat goes completely limp and plays dead the moment the carrier comes out for the yearly vet visit, then makes a miraculous recovery in the waiting room and rolls around purring for the receptionist

tracks.title: 一センチ
tracks.subject: a fifty-two-year-old man at his company health check who is told he has shrunk one centimetre since last year, measures himself twice more, and walks back to the office through the station with his chin up as if he can stretch it back

tracks.title: 松の木さわれない
tracks.mood: fidgety, self-mocking and light on its feet
tracks.subject: a man who buys a thirty-year-old black pine bonsai at a garden fair and is too scared to trim a single needle, phoning the old seller every Sunday for advice until the seller tells him the tree was doing fine before he bought it

tracks.title: 自販機の前で止まる
tracks.subject: a woman whose shiba inu plants itself in front of one particular drink vending machine on every morning walk and refuses to move until she buys a can of corn soup she does not even want, which the dog only wants to watch roll out

tracks.title: りんご十キロ東京駅
tracks.subject: a man hauling a ten-kilo cardboard box of Aomori apples his aunt forced on him through Tokyo Station at morning rush hour, handing an apple to every commuter who bumps into the box until it is light enough to carry

tracks.title: 三年ボトル
tracks.subject: the mama-san of a tiny Shinjuku snack bar who keeps a regular's half-finished shochu bottle with his name tag on the shelf for three years after he transferred to Osaka, dusting it every Friday, until one ordinary Tuesday he walks in and asks if it is still there

tracks.title: ひじのパッチ
tracks.mood: sweet, tender and a little goofy
tracks.subject: a young man whose girlfriend sews two lopsided felt patches shaped like rice balls onto the worn-through elbows of his only good sweater, which he now wears to work every day and refuses to let anyone call cute

tracks.title: ベランダ・プール
tracks.subject: a man who buys a four-metre inflatable pool at a closing-down sale for 980 yen and fills it with a bucket and a kettle on his tiny apartment balcony until it covers the whole balcony and he sits in it with cold barley tea

tracks.title: プシュッとこないで
tracks.subject: a young woman at an eye clinic who cannot stop blinking before the air-puff eye-pressure test, flinching on every countdown while the nurse patiently resets the machine, until she finally keeps her eyes open on the seventh try

tracks.title: チョキしか出せない
tracks.mood: teasing, warm and quietly in love
tracks.subject: a young man who loses rock-paper-scissors to his girlfriend every burnable-garbage morning over who takes the bags out, and admits in the song that he knows she always throws rock and plays scissors on purpose so he can walk her to the corner

tracks.title: 五時五十八分
tracks.subject: a man who takes a day off to wait for the plumber to fix a dripping kitchen tap, told only 'sometime between nine and six', counting the drips into a measuring cup all day until the plumber rings the bell at 5:58 and fixes it in four minutes

tracks.title: 名前入りの弁当箱
tracks.subject: a thirty-year-old woman who finds her old primary-school bento box at her mother's house with her name still written on the lid in her mother's marker, takes it back to the city and starts carrying lunch to the office in it, and her colleague asks whose name that is

tracks.title: ネジが一本足りない
tracks.mood: flustered, cocky and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a man assembling a flat-pack wardrobe alone on a Saturday, discovering one screw is missing so a door hangs crooked, while a wooden dowel is somehow left over and fits no hole

tracks.title: 最後に来たのはいつですか
tracks.subject: a man who has dodged the dentist for three years, finally walks in with a cracked filling, and freezes when the hygienist asks when he last came

tracks.title: ツナマヨふたつ
tracks.subject: two regulars at the same konbini at 11pm who keep reaching for the last tuna-mayo onigiri, until one night he buys two and hands her one, and they eat side by side at the guardrail outside

tracks.title: ボックスシーツのたたみかた
tracks.subject: a twenty-something living alone who finds a children's-TV-style how-to song in his head while trying, and failing, to fold a fitted bedsheet with elastic corners on a Sunday afternoon

tracks.title: ビート板は二枚まで
tracks.subject: a forty-two-year-old office worker in a ward-pool adult beginners' swimming class on Thursday nights, the oldest of six, finally letting go of his second kickboard and making twenty-five metres of crawl while the seventy-year-old woman in the next lane cheers

tracks.title: トング係
tracks.mood: flustered, eager and finally triumphant, a workplace comedy you can dance to
tracks.subject: a new hire at her first welcome party (歓迎会) at a yakiniku restaurant, handed the tongs by her section chief and put in charge of grilling for the whole table of eight, juggling who wants their meat rare, the burning tare and the chief's order of tongue first

tracks.title: こたつで千ピース
tracks.mood: hyperactive, nerdy and stubbornly proud, a grandpa's personal-best comedy
tracks.subject: a retired salaryman alone at the kotatsu over one winter weekend, timing himself on a stopwatch to finish the 1000-piece Mount Fuji jigsaw his grandson did in nine hours at New Year, sorting edge pieces into a biscuit tin and losing an hour to a sky made of nothing but blue

tracks.title: ハウスの朝
tracks.subject: a young couple who grow strawberries in Moka, Tochigi, picking tochiaika in the greenhouse at 5:30 on January mornings; he packs the boxes so she can pick at her own pace, and they split a can of hot oshiruko on the way back from the farm stand

tracks.title: 開かねえ
tracks.subject: a young man in Asahikawa at six in the morning at minus twenty-five whose car door handle and lock are frozen solid before work, scraping ice with a point card and warming the key with a lighter, until he gets in through the passenger door

tracks.title: 挟まれたもみじ
tracks.subject: a ward library staffer in November who keeps finding a pressed maple leaf inside different returned books each week, is not allowed to check the borrowing records to find out who, and one morning tucks a ginkgo leaf into the book as a reply

tracks.title: 二割まで
tracks.subject: a man whose dropped wallet comes back from the Tokyo police lost-property centre with every last coin, agonising by the phone over whether to give the high-school baseball player who found it five percent or the full twenty percent reward

tracks.title: 雪の大谷攻城戦
tracks.subject: an April snow-clearing crew on the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route cutting the 20-metre 'snow corridor' at Murodo open with a rotary snow plough, the foreman directing it like a castle siege, the bus road due to open to tourists in a week

tracks.title: 赤で「残す」
tracks.genre: Japanese a cappella vocal group pop
tracks.subject: a junior editor at a dictionary publisher who falls for the proofreader across the desk island; during the revision he slips a new example sentence for 恋 into the draft, and the galley comes back with her red-pen mark: 残す

tracks.title: 橋をたたく
tracks.subject: an expressway bridge inspector who closes one lane at ten at night and works under the deck until dawn, tapping the concrete with a hammer and circling every spot that sounds hollow in chalk

tracks.title: 日曜は二百メートル
tracks.subject: a man walking his twenty-two-year-old, thirty-kilo spurred tortoise along the riverbank every Sunday morning, two hundred metres an hour with dandelion stops, and carrying him home in his arms

tracks.title: 放水始め
tracks.mood: sweaty, heroic and a little ridiculous
tracks.subject: a bicycle-shop owner in his town's volunteer fire brigade, drilling every July night behind the community hall under a captain with a stopwatch for the prefectural fire-pump drill competition, where a twisted hose costs them points and they finish ninth

tracks.title: 全員上がって
tracks.subject: a university student working as a municipal-pool lifeguard in a 38-degree heatwave, booed by the whole pool every time he blows the whistle for the hourly ten-minute break and cheered when he lets them back in

tracks.title: 鳴らしてみてよ
tracks.subject: a flamenco guitarist who plays Friday nights at a small Spanish restaurant, finally handed the cypress guitar that the quiet luthier at the end of the counter spent two winters building, sized to her hands and with her name on the label inside

tracks.title: 笑われたら勝ち
tracks.subject: an apprentice chindon-ya in white face paint carrying the drum rig at her first All-Japan Chindon Contest in Toyama, botching her pitch for the July baseball All-Star Game so badly the crowd roars, and being told she will do the patter from tomorrow

tracks.title: ただのカード
tracks.subject: a retired man who rides one-car local trains on summer weekdays to small-town city halls to collect the free municipal manhole cards, the only adult in a queue of children on summer holiday at the sewerage counter, until a clerk runs out in her sandals to show him the real painted cover on the crossing outside

tracks.title: 君の天気予報
tracks.subject: a man who watches his girlfriend present the local evening weather forecast every night and leaves his umbrella at home whenever she says it will be fine, even after she got it wrong and he came home soaked

tracks.title: 行かないで焼き芋屋さん
tracks.subject: running out in sandals on a winter Friday night after the stone-baked sweet-potato truck's loudspeaker call and finally catching it at the shrine slope for the last 800-yen potato

tracks.title: 一音目で払ってやる
tracks.subject: a first-year in a high-school competitive karuta club at the July tournament at Ōmi Jingū, sweeping cards across the tatami before the reader finishes the first syllable, against a smug third-year from a rival school who sneered at her

tracks.title: 片耳のトラ
tracks.subject: a one-eared ginger stray who rules a shopping street meeting a fluffy white house cat on a pink harness outside the croquette shop, and hiding behind the shop girl's legs

tracks.title: シナノキの六月
tracks.subject: an urban beekeeper who keeps hives on the roof of a Ginza department store, lifting the frames at noon above the lunchtime crowds and tasting the honey turn minty when the street's linden trees flower in June

tracks.title: 帯の結び方
tracks.subject: a boyfriend who secretly learns to tie a yukata obi from videos so he can dress her for the summer fireworks festival

tracks.title: ひまわりの種
tracks.mood: bouncy, carefree and a little silly
tracks.subject: hunting for an escaped hamster around a small apartment at midnight with a trail of sunflower seeds and a flashlight

tracks.title: おなか引っこめて
tracks.subject: the morning of the company health check: fasting since nine the night before and holding your breath for the waist measurement

tracks.title: 三回目の貸出延長
tracks.subject: renewing the same library novel for the third time without having read past page forty

tracks.title: ガチャあと一回
tracks.subject: feeding three-hundred-yen coins into a capsule-toy machine for the one missing figure, a cat in a teacup

tracks.title: 袋詰めエリア
tracks.mood: flustered, comic, getting angrier and funnier
tracks.subject: losing a ten-minute argument with a supermarket self-checkout that keeps saying an item is in the bagging area

tracks.title: 改札前ダンス
tracks.subject: a girl who practises a dance challenge in the dark glass by the station ticket gates every morning, until the salaryman who waits there starts copying the moves

tracks.title: 借りたままのベース
tracks.subject: taking the train across town to return a bass guitar to a bandmate who quit the band two years ago

tracks.title: 片耳ずつ
tracks.genre: Japanese liquid drum and bass pop
tracks.subject: an overnight highway bus from Osaka to Tokyo, sharing one pair of earbuds with your boyfriend while he falls asleep on your shoulder

tracks.title: 曲がったキュウリ
tracks.subject: an old man whose community-garden cucumbers all grew curled, handing them out door to door in his apartment block anyway

tracks.title: 大凶スタート
tracks.subject: drawing daikyō, the worst possible fortune, at the shrine on New Year's morning and deciding it can only go up from here

tracks.title: まだ蓋は開けない
tracks.mood: patient, wry and quietly content on her own
tracks.subject: learning to cook rice in a clay donabe after the rice cooker dies, three burnt bottoms before one pot comes out right, eaten alone at the low table with a raw egg

tracks.title: あぶら少なめ
tracks.subject: a ramen shop's new part-timer on her first Saturday lunch rush, learning the 36-button meal-ticket machine and the regulars' 'katame, koime, abura-sukuname' orders, and getting the last one right

tracks.title: 火曜は燃える
tracks.subject: a newcomer's rubbish bag left behind with a yellow sticker, and the woman across the street who comes down to teach him the sorting rules

tracks.title: 最後はカチャーシー
tracks.subject: a Tokyo friend of the groom pulled up by the bride's grandmother to dance kachashi at the end of a three-hundred-guest Okinawan wedding reception

tracks.title: スヌーズ九回目
tracks.subject: the ninth press of the snooze button and a ten-minute sprint for the 7:02 train

tracks.title: 最終のあとで
tracks.subject: the overnight track-maintenance crew who check and grind the rails between the last train at midnight and the first train at six

tracks.title: たこ焼き説明すな
tracks.subject: a man from Tokyo on his first Osaka trip explaining to an Osaka-born woman, at a takoyaki stall, how takoyaki is supposed to be eaten

tracks.title: 皿洗いは一本勝負
tracks.subject: a couple settling whose turn it is to wash up with one round of an old two-player video game from his parents' house, where she has not lost in two years until she loses on purpose on his birthday

tracks.title: 二百十七番
tracks.mood: crushed, deadpan and bored out of its mind
tracks.subject: four hours on a ward office bench holding number ticket 217

tracks.title: 半額シールの王
tracks.subject: waiting at the supermarket deli counter at closing time for the half-price stickers to go on

tracks.title: 鏡代わり
tracks.subject: five friends practising choreography at night in the dark glass of a closed office building

tracks.title: ミルクは二秒
tracks.mood: happily in love on a slow morning
tracks.subject: knowing exactly how long to pour the milk into your girlfriend's Sunday coffee

tracks.title: 保管所まで二駅
tracks.subject: taking the train two stops to pay 2,500 yen and get your bicycle back from the city impound lot

tracks.title: じいちゃん、うるせえ
tracks.subject: a first-timer carrying the neighbourhood mikoshi at the summer matsuri in a borrowed happi coat while an old barber shouts corrections from the roadside

tracks.title: 場所取り
tracks.subject: the newest employee guarding the company's cherry-blossom picnic spot on a blue tarp from six in the morning

tracks.title: かき氷四杯目
tracks.subject: ordering a fourth shaved ice at a beach hut just to talk to the girl behind the counter

tracks.title: ネジが一本余る
tracks.mood: deadpan irritation that ends in a shrug
tracks.subject: finishing a flat-pack bookshelf alone and finding one screw left over on the floor

tracks.title: 透明な傘
tracks.subject: someone taking your clear plastic umbrella from the stand outside a convenience store on a rainy night

tracks.title: また同じ歌
tracks.subject: an old wife on Amami teasing her husband for playing the same sanshin song every evening for forty years

tracks.title: 階段ダッシュ
tracks.mood: a daily race with a stranger you never speak to
tracks.subject: running up forty-three station stairs every morning beside the same stranger

tracks.title: 湯上がり
tracks.mood: the emptiest your head gets all day
tracks.subject: a four-hundred-and-fifty-yen public bath and a bottle of milk afterwards

tracks.title: 配信終了
tracks.mood: one second of being named, then your own face in a black screen
tracks.subject: the moment a livestream ends and the screen goes dark

tracks.title: ネイル三時間
tracks.mood: honesty you can only manage with a stranger
tracks.subject: three hours in a nail salon next to a stranger with an interview tomorrow

tracks.title: 朝セリ
tracks.mood: inheriting a voice you are not big enough for yet
tracks.subject: a son standing where his father called fish auctions for fifty years

tracks.title: 回覧板
tracks.mood: belonging you only notice when you break it
tracks.subject: the neighbourhood circular notice board that is passed house to house

tracks.title: 自販機の下
tracks.subject: fishing coins out from under a vending machine with a ruler

tracks.title: 二十年同じ髪型
tracks.mood: comfort you are not sure you chose
tracks.subject: twenty years of the same haircut from the same barber

tracks.title: 駅のピアノ
tracks.mood: a city being gentle without admitting it
tracks.subject: the public piano outside the ticket gates and the people who stop for it

tracks.title: 年賀状をやめる
tracks.subject: writing one extra line on thirty-eight new year cards to say it is the last one

tracks.title: 二次会は行かない
tracks.subject: getting out of the second round of a work drinking party

tracks.title: 台風の日の配達
tracks.subject: finishing a delivery round in a typhoon for two seconds of a door opening

tracks.title: 弟の運動会
tracks.subject: being the youngest person in the parents' seats at a twelve-years-younger brother's sports day

tracks.title: 片付けが本番
tracks.subject: taking down the school festival decorations after everyone has gone

tracks.title: 古本屋に自分の本を売る
tracks.subject: selling seventy-two of your own books and keeping the one with pencil notes in it

tracks.title: シャッターの鍵
tracks.subject: 畳んだ父の店の鍵を受け取る

tracks.title: 七時十二分の各停
tracks.subject: 毎朝同じ各停に乗る

tracks.title: 県道沿い
tracks.subject: 東京から戻った男の話

tracks.title: まだ直さない
tracks.subject: 壊れたまま置いてある物

tracks.title: 指が痛い
tracks.subject: ライブハウスで弾き続ける手

tracks.title: 始発を待つ
tracks.subject: waiting for the first train of the morning

tracks.title: 海岸通り
tracks.subject: a coastal road at night

tracks.title: 北の宿
tracks.subject: an inn in the snow country

tracks.title: 工場の煙突
tracks.subject: a factory town

tracks.title: 六畳
tracks.subject: a six-mat room

tracks.title: 最終便
tracks.subject: the last flight of the night

tracks.title: アーケード
tracks.subject: a covered shopping arcade

tracks.title: 祖母の手
tracks.subject: a grandmother's hands

tracks.title: 終電まで
tracks.subject: a convenience store night shift

tracks.title: 波が戻る
tracks.subject: a tide returning
